_comment: Additional training negatives: real, cluttered, in-the-wild people, with no screen, whiteboard or document text. Fixes the person covariate shift, where probe FP was 51%.
_distinct_from_probe: The query wording is deliberately different from keywords_probe.json so it does not pull the same photographs. The global Pexels-ID dedup in download_images.py, with --output-root data, additionally skips anything already in data/raw (training) or data/probe_person_noscreen (the probe).
_holdout_guard: The probe set is a held-out test set and never enters training. This config downloads to data/negative_people_inscene/, physically separate from data/probe_person_noscreen/. After ingest, run check_leakage plus the probe overlap check, by ID and perceptual hash, to confirm zero overlap.
_manual_qc: After downloading, manually remove any image containing readable screen, whiteboard, document or slide text. Meeting and office scenes are especially prone to including a screen. Otherwise positives end up in the negative class.
_usage: python3 scripts/download_images.py --config scripts/keywords_train_inscene.json --output-root data  (writes data/negative_people_inscene/<slug>/; --output-root data makes the dedup baseline cover data/raw plus data/probe_person_noscreen)
_count_plan: Planned ceiling of 240. After ID dedup, manual removal of screens and perceptual dedup, the net yield is about 200, entering training as the new negative subclass negative_people_inscene.
